svg.title: M01 Four ways to make a pole
svg.text: M01 Four ways to make one magnet pole: curved arc or flat blocks
One pole cut across, drawn 9× real size. Drum on top, stator at the bottom, red = N pole, blue = next (S) pole.
EMF 387 V torque 803 Nm cogging 1.01 Nm
magnet heat 11 W with 4 pieces along · magnets 6.65 kg
2 part numbers (N and S), ground curved faces
EMF 364 V torque 755 Nm cogging 1.06 Nm
magnet heat 9 W with 4 pieces along · magnets 6.57 kg
bond 0.73 mm thick in the middle, −6 % EMF
EMF 376 V torque 780 Nm cogging 1.58 Nm
magnet heat 8 W with 2 pieces along · magnets 6.46 kg
EMF 381 V torque 790 Nm cogging 0.96 Nm
magnet heat 13 W with 2 pieces along · magnets 6.92 kg
1 part number, turn it over for S. 160 pieces
